obernants.approximation_semantics: Exact conditional mathematical relation, bounded executable evidence only.
obernants.assumptions: Sufficient allocation; validated bounded graph domain. Finite checks are not universal proofs.
obernants.domain: Finite generated test fixtures and observation Pass or a named assertion failure; ordinary Rust execution.
obernants.observation_scope: One call or one bounded test suite.
obernants.operator: For a fixed fixture collection, Pass is excluded if any production observation differs from the independent oracle or validation assertion; a named Failure is excluded when its compared values agree. This relation excludes false-green and false-red harness observations; tests do not approximate unexecuted inputs.

obernants.operator: Pass admits every implementation agreeing on all finite fixtures, including implementations that disagree elsewhere. Failure at fixture f admits implementations with its reported mismatch; it does not recover a unique bug. Distinct programs with identical observed fixture results lie in the same preimage.

obernants.operator: Flow enumerates feasible edge assignments rather than residual paths; MCS checks all priority inequalities rather than updating weights; core unions all feasible subsets rather than peeling; dominators deletes candidate vertices rather than intersecting sets; reduction deletes each edge rather than Warshall reduction. The applicable independent characterization detects semantic disagreement.
